extractor.schema: schema/v1: 3-6 options w/ explicit definitions; unclear option required

learner.C_selection: once per seed on the empty-bank baseline (all 5 discovery folds); fixed for all arms and candidates
learner.fitting: vectorizer/IDF/scaler/classifier fit strictly within training folds; no panel re-selection during search

selector.rule: budgeted greedy forward selection; up to two single-question swaps per limit per round; fixed-reference corrected screen only in this selector; no rolling allowance, no single-fold removals
selector.tie_rule: greatest CV; ties: lower latency, fewer questions, canonical hash order
selector.archive: nondominated quality-cost per limit, cap 30, prior feasible banks retained

packets.R: 8 random class-balanced pairs (cap 2/class), same fields as E, no error conditioning
packets.E: 5 failure pairs (cap 2/class then 3, deterministic fallback) + 3 preservation controls
packets.F: E + absolute limits, measured current latency, per-question cost estimates, archive (latest ≤8 entries), replacement permission
packets.fields: text (≤200 chars), true intent, prediction, top-2 probabilities; current CV macro-F1; worst-12 classes; top-12 confusions

limits_policy.reference: supervised Choice readout (150-option task question + LR) measured per seed on the first 128 discovery rows
limits_policy.benchmark: batched size 64 end-to-end (encode+forward+prob processing+TF-IDF+LR predict), fresh extraction (no cached semantics), warmup 1 chunk excluded; single-request p50/p95 secondary

ceilings.unfinished_round_rule: a round hit by a ceiling completes with what fits; unextracted proposals are discarded and logged; the run stops after that round

accounting.extraction: logical charge = n_texts x unit cost per arm; physical shared-cache cost also recorded; different resources reported as separate axes
accounting.candidate_evals: unique candidate-bank CV evaluations counted; exact reuses hit cache

endpoints.primary: mean paired test macro-F1 difference F - E for the final frozen pipelines at L_primary
endpoints.success_rule: mean F-E >= 0.010 AND positive paired difference in >= 4 of 5 seeds AND actual feasibility under L_primary AND reported intervals/seed analysis
endpoints.intervals: paired bootstrap over test messages with identical resamples
endpoints.secondary_policy: E-R, E-U, TFIDF+bank gain, all three limits, checkpoints vs charged compute, accuracy/wF1, question/option counts, fidelity — descriptive, multiplicity declared
endpoints.mcnemar_note: McNemar evaluates paired binary correctness only, not macro-F1

confirmation.evaluations: one, without revision; frozen banks only
confirmation.final_refit: same frozen pipelines refit on all 3000 permitted labels (discovery+confirmation), single official-test evaluation (4500)
confirmation.test_set_use: registered final evaluation only; latency descriptive, never triggers bank replacement

criterion_v2_active.discrimination: mean top-1 prob on correct > on incorrect

audit_criterion.note: v1 was applied as written and FAILED on macro-F1 due to rare-class statistics (e.g., a concept with 100% agreement scoring 0.25 macro-F1 because positive classes held 0-1 examples) — a battery-design flaw discovered by the audit itself, before any confirmation access. v2 (agreement + discrimination) was declared before confirmation and is the active gate; both results recorded. Audit labels = independent annotator + researcher adjudication (human panel recommended for strict replication).
